note: Threshold profiles for `qc-audio --qc-profile`. Only thresholds implemented by the tool appear here. Loudness and true peak are deliberately absent because sample-accurate LUFS/true-peak measurement is not implemented; use a dedicated meter for delivery compliance.

default.description: General purpose: catches truncated files, silence, and hard clipping.

strict-master.description: Full-length masters: leaves headroom for lossy encoding and rejects sub-30s files.

sample-pack.description: One-shots and loops: short files are legitimate, but silence is usually a render error.

spoken-word.description: Podcast and voiceover files, including long episodes.

archive-integrity.description: Integrity-only pass over an archive: header and readability checks, levels ignored.
